pids.name: Exhaust differential pressure
pids.group: เครื่องยนต์
pids.desc: This sensor is crucial for monitoring how clogged the DPF has become. It measures the pressure before and after the DPF in the exhaust system, with the difference between these two measurements indicating how restricted the filter has become. When the pressure difference becomes too high (indicating a clogged filter), the ECM will initiate a regeneration process to burn off the accumulated soot and clean the filter.
